# FlowForge — Code-First Workflow Engine

> FlowForge is a TypeScript-native workflow engine for defining, executing, and monitoring workflows entirely in code.

## Quick Start

```bash
npm install @flowforge/sdk @flowforge/engine
```

```typescript
import { defineNode, workflow } from '@flowforge/sdk';
import { Engine } from '@flowforge/engine';
import { z } from 'zod';

const greet = defineNode({
  name: 'greet',
  version: '1.0.0',
  description: 'Greets a user',
  category: 'custom',
  inputSchema: z.object({ name: z.string() }),
  outputSchema: z.string(),
  configSchema: z.object({}),
  handler: async (ctx) => `Hello, ${ctx.input.name}!`,
});

const wf = workflow('hello')
  .trigger({ type: 'manual' })
  .node('greet', greet)
  .build();

const engine = new Engine();
engine.register(wf);
const run = await engine.trigger('hello', { name: 'World' });
console.log(run.output); // "Hello, World!"
```

## Packages

- `@flowforge/sdk` — Workflow DSL: `defineNode()`, `defineAgentNode()`, `workflow()` builder
- `@flowforge/engine` — In-memory execution engine with DAG scheduling, retry, event bus
- `@flowforge/worker` — Production worker: BullMQ queues, Hono HTTP API, Drizzle/Postgres persistence
- `@flowforge/nodes` — 34 built-in nodes: data, communication, AI, control flow, transform
- `@flowforge/integrations` — Integration service: Slack, Email, Discord, GitHub, Notion, Telegram, Stripe, Webhook
- `@flowforge/cli` — Developer CLI: init, dev, emit, runs, node validate/test/docs, secrets, deploy
- `@flowforge/dashboard` — Monitoring API: workflows, runs, events, metrics, SSE streaming
- `@flowforge/test-utils` — Testing: mock context, mock logger, test runner for node authors
- `@flowforge/shared` — Shared types, errors, schemas, constants

## Node Definition Interface

Every node implements `NodeDefinition<TInput, TOutput, TConfig>`:
- `name`, `version`, `description`, `category`
- `inputSchema`, `outputSchema`, `configSchema` (Zod)
- `handler(ctx: NodeContext)` — receives input, config, event, steps, logger, ai, pull/push/integrate/emit/wait/sleep/checkpoint

## Workflow Builder

```typescript
workflow('pipeline')
  .trigger({ type: 'event', event: 'order.created' })
  .node('validate', validateNode)
  .node('process', processNode, { input: (ctx) => ctx.steps['validate'] })
  .parallel('fan-out', { items: (ctx) => ctx.event.data.items, concurrency: 10, pipeline: ... })
  .if('check', { condition: ..., then: [...], else: [...] })
  .build()
```

## Built-in Node Categories

### Data (8): postgres, redis, mongodb, s3, http, elasticsearch, kafka, pinecone
### Communication (9): slack, email-smtp, email-resend, discord, github, notion, telegram, webhook, stripe
### AI (4): generate-text, generate-object, embed, agent
### Control (8): delay, if, switch, parallel, forEach, while, wait-for-event, sub-workflow
### Transform (4): map, filter, reduce, template
### Log (1): console
